workflow: Built-in ImageGen style-transfer on seven completed E-design card backs, using current project card-art style references
user_instruction: 再叠一次我们项目的通用画风

items.name: 行囊粗布
items.keep: Preserve the folded tan canvas, cyan compass-star inside its diamond opening, winding teal rope, small compass charm and existing straps. Group the cloth into main fold planes and the rope into a few broad turns; replace miniature brocade-like fabric patterns with calm ochre color areas and a few major stitches.
items.imagegen_prompt: STYLE-TRANSFER EDIT of Input 1 only, ONE complete portrait 2:3 card-back artwork. Input 1 is the current finished card back: preserve its composition, object arrangement, relative sizes, palette, central vertical framework and distinctive subject. Inputs 2, 3, 4 are our PROJECT'S ACTUAL CARD ART STYLE references, in order chase-slash, initial attack and treasure-hunt. Borrow their large connected color planes, broad directional opaque brush construction, hard grouped shadows, selective midtone turns and low-detail hand-painted anime illustration finish. Do not copy their weapons, chest, slash beams, subjects, poses or backgrounds. The requested change is the drawing style, not the design. Preserve the folded tan canvas, cyan compass-star inside its diamond opening, winding teal rope, small compass charm and existing straps. Group the cloth into main fold planes and the rope into a few broad turns; replace miniature brocade-like fabric patterns with calm ochre color areas and a few major stitches. PAINTING: complete readable silhouettes and clear structure, simplified interiors. Build each material from substantial connected opaque color masses and a few broad curved/elongated swipes that explain form direction. Handmade edges, varied stroke width, a few deliberate structural accents and restrained highlights; enough quiet surfaces to breathe. Keep grouped light/shadow and existing warm/cool color relationships. Reduce fine ornamental linework, dense engraving, scale grids, floral fabric micro-patterns, stone cracks and uniform aged/grain texture; simplify the existing background cloud pattern into a few broad subdued shapes. Do not replace fine detail with thousands of little brush flakes or triangular facets. Keep the same CLOSED continuous metal border on ALL FOUR sides and all FOUR angular corners, the same thickness and inset boundary, expressed through broad dark planes and a few large antique-gold edge strokes. Do not remove, thin away or crop the enclosing frame. No glossy 3D, photoreal material, flat one-tone vector filling, airbrushed polish, all-over texture filters, words, logos, numbers, UI or card mockup. Full bleed, no outside margin.
